scenes.say: Does your frame really fit you? Three quick checks.

scenes.en: The centre of each lens must sit in front of your pupil.
scenes.ta: லென்ஸின் மையம் கண்மணிக்கு நேராக இருக்க வேண்டும்
scenes.say: Why does fit matter? The centre of each lens must sit right in front of your pupil. A loose or crooked frame shifts it, and your eyes work harder.

scenes.en: Frame as wide as your face. No pressing on temples, no gaps.
scenes.say: Check one. Width. The frame should be about as wide as your face, without pressing on your temples or leaving big gaps.

scenes.en: Rests on your nose. No sliding down, no red marks.
scenes.say: Check two. The bridge. It should rest gently on your nose. If it keeps sliding down or leaves red marks, it does not fit.

scenes.en: Arms curve softly behind the ears. No pain.
scenes.say: Check three. The arms. They should curve softly behind your ears, with no pain after a few hours.

scenes.en: On spectacles with LenzKare Fusion lenses. Frames from ₹899.
scenes.say: Get it fitted right. Buy one, get one free on spectacles with LenzKare Fusion lenses. Frames start from eight hundred and ninety-nine rupees, with a six-month frame warranty.

scenes.en: Free eye test in store. We adjust your frame for you.
scenes.say: Come to our store for a free eye test, and we will adjust your frame for you.
